assessments.reasoning:
The survey captures economic maintenance and labor burden separately at the individual member level, but does not capture dwelling tenure at the member level or intra-household decision-making across spheres. Specifically:
- economic_maintenance is true: Income from wages, informal/independent work, pensions, alimony, and remittances are recorded per individual person in Section I (Q17, Q32, Q33, Q48, Q73) and Section L (Q2, Q4).
- labor_burden is true: Hours spent in paid work are collected per member in Section I (Q52, Q54), and hours spent in unpaid domestic chores and care activities are captured per member in Section K (Q1–Q6).
- property_asset_control is false: Dwelling tenure is collected as a single household-level question in Section C (Q9) for the household as a whole, rather than being recorded by individual member.
- decision_making is false: The survey lacks questions on intra-household decision-making by sphere (such as child-rearing, daily consumption, or financial choices). The only decision questions present (Section I, Q28–Q30) relate exclusively to independent work/business management.
